DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25210-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25210-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 木の写真を見比べていらっしゃるのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25210-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are comparing photos of the tree, I see.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25210-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25210-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 先月より大きくなったと子どもへ言いましたが、今回は近づいて撮っています。写真の大きさだけでは比べられませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25210-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 撮影距離差を無視し木が成長したと話したことを見直す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25210-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I told my child it had grown since last month, but this time I took the photo from closer up. We cannot compare it just by its size in the photos.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25210-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Reconsider saying the tree had grown while ignoring the difference in camera distance. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25210-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25210-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 撮った位置も違うようですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25210-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: It seems you took them from different positions, too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25210-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25210-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 先月は園路の分かれ道、今日は幹の近くでした。枝が伸びたと決めて記録するのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25210-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 前後の立位置を示し画像サイズで枝成長を断定しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25210-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Last month I stood at the fork in the park path; today I was close to the trunk. I will stop recording it as definite branch growth.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25210-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Describe the earlier and current standing positions, and do not conclude from image size that the branches grew. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25210-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25210-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: これから同じ場所で観察するなら、立つ位置を覚えておけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25210-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: If you observe it from the same place from now on, you can keep track of where you stand.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25210-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25210-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かれ道の案内札から見ることにします。地面へ印を描くのではなく、ノートに位置を書いておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25210-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 固定観察位置を選び地面印でなくノートへ記す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25210-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will view it from the sign at the fork. Instead of drawing a mark on the ground, I will write the location in my notebook.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25210-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose a fixed observation position and record it in a notebook rather than marking the ground. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25210-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25210-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 通行する方の邪魔にならない位置でお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25210-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please choose a position that does not obstruct people passing by.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25210-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25210-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 人が通る時は避けます。写真だけでなく、今日は芽を見つけたという実際の観察も書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25210-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 通行を避け写真と実際の芽発見を別記する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25210-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will move aside when people pass. Besides the photos, I will also write down my actual observation that I found buds today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25210-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Avoid obstructing passersby and record the photos and the actual discovery of buds separately. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25210-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25210-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 観察した物が分かるよう、日付も添えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25210-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please add the date so that it is clear what you observed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25210-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25210-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 日付と立つ場所、芽を見たことを分けて残します。今日は大きくなったという結論は書きません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25210-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 日付位置観察を残し今日成長結論は保留すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25210-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will record the date, where I stood, and seeing the buds separately. Today I will not write the conclusion that it has grown.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25210-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will record the date, position, and observations, and withhold a conclusion about growth today. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25210-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25210-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、これからの観察もお楽しみください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25210-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please enjoy your future observations, too. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 切符を確認します。お手元にありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: I will check your ticket. Do you have it with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ありますが、両手に飲み物を持っていて出せません。友人の分も持ったまま窓口へ来てしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二人分の飲物で両手が塞がり切符を出せないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I do, but I have drinks in both hands and cannot take it out. I came to the counter still holding my friend's drink as well.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that drinks for two people occupy both hands, so you cannot take out your ticket. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まず安定して持てる状態にしてからお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please first get into a position where you can hold them securely.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 友人は隣にいます。友人の飲み物を本人へ返して、一つだけ持つようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同行友人へ本人の飲物を返して一つに減らす。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: My friend is beside me. I will return my friend's drink to them and hold just one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Return your accompanying friend's own drink to them so that you are holding only one. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 切符は濡れていませんか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 上着の内側に入れているので濡れていません。冷たい容器の水滴が付かないよう、飲み物は左手へ持ち替えました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 切符無濡れと水滴を避け飲物左持替えを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: It is inside my jacket, so it is not wet. I moved the drink to my left hand to keep condensation from the cold container off it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that the ticket is dry and you moved the drink to your left hand to avoid water droplets. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その状態で、切符の面を見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: With things like that, could you show me the face of the ticket?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 右手で出せました。ここへ飲み物を置いてもらうより、自分で持ったまま見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 右手で切符を示し飲物を窓口へ置かない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I managed to take it out with my right hand. Rather than having you put my drink here, I will show you the ticket while holding the drink myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the ticket with your right hand without putting the drink on the counter. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 切符を確認できました。お返しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: I have checked your ticket. Here it is back.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 受け取りました。切符をしまってから友人と移動します。両方の飲み物をまた引き受けて手がふさがらないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 返却切符を収納後移動し再び両飲物を引受けないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have it. I will put the ticket away before moving on with my friend. I will avoid taking both drinks again and having my hands full.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will put the returned ticket away before leaving and will not take both drinks again. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、ご一緒にお気をつけて。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then both of you, take care. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 写真展の応募について、ご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about entering the photography exhibition?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 一枚出したいです。題名を「昔の湖南」にしましたが、写真は昨日撮った今の町並みです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 現在撮影なのに昔の町題名を付けたと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to submit one photo. I titled it 'Old Konan,' but it is a photo of the present streetscape that I took yesterday.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about having given a present-day photo a title suggesting the town in the past. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 昔の写真ではなく、現在の町並みということですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: So it is the current streetscape, rather than an old photograph?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。古い建物があるので昔と書きましたが、撮影した年代まで昔と受け取られそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 建物古さと写真年代の誤解懸念を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I wrote 'old' because there are old buildings, but people might take it to mean that the photo itself was taken long ago.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain your concern about confusing the age of the buildings with when the photo was taken. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 題名と撮影年月の欄を分けて記入できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can fill in the title and the month and year taken in separate fields.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 撮影年月には今月を書きます。題名は「帰り道の古い壁」にして、昨日見た風景だと説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 現撮影年月と具体的な帰路題名へ分けて記入する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will put this month in the date field. I will title it 'The Old Wall on My Way Home' and explain that it is a scene I saw yesterday.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Enter the current shooting month and year separately from a specific title about the way home. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 写っている場所や、応募についての条件もご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also check the location shown and the conditions for submitting entries.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 条件を読みました。道から撮った写真で、他人の家の中に入って撮った物ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 条件確認と公道撮影で他人室内侵入なしを述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I read the conditions. It was taken from the road; I did not enter someone else's home to take it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you checked the conditions and took it from a public road without entering someone else's home. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 応募用の説明は、ご自身の写真に合っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Does the description for your entry fit your own photo?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 撮った場所と日付を見直しました。古さの印象を題名にしても、撮影年を昔へ変えることはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 場所日付を照合し印象で撮影年は変えないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I checked the place and date again. Even if the title conveys an impression of age, I will not change the shooting year to one in the past.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you checked the place and date and will not change the shooting year based on an impression. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、応募の内容をお預かりします。ありがとうございました。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will accept your entry details. Thank you. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 先ほどお呼びした際、いらっしゃいませんでしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Were you not here when we called you earlier?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 席にいました。声を出して答えたのですが、小さくて届かなかったようです。呼ばれていないと思って帰ったわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 在席し小声返答が届かず帰宅した訳ではないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I was in my seat. I answered aloud, but my voice seems to have been too quiet to reach you. I did not go home thinking I had not been called.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you were present, your quiet reply was not heard, and you did not go home. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お名前と受付の番号を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will confirm your name and reception number.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: リンです。番号はこの紙のとおりです。座っていたのは奥の椅子で、ここから見えにくかったと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 氏名番号と奥席から見えづらかった状況を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: My name is Lin. My number is as shown on this paper. I was sitting in a chair at the back, so I think it was hard to see me from here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give your name and number and explain that you were hard to see in the back seat. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今、声を出す時に痛みなどはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you have any pain or other discomfort when speaking now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 痛みはありません。大勢の前で大きな声を出すのが苦手なので、次は手も上げて知らせてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 発声無痛と大声苦手を伝え手上げ合図を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have no pain. I find it difficult to speak loudly in front of many people, so may I also raise my hand to let you know next time?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that speaking does not hurt but raising your voice is difficult, and ask about signaling with a raised hand. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらから見える所で、手を上げてお知らせください。移動できる席をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please raise your hand where we can see you. I will show you a seat you can move to.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 通路をふさがない前の席へ移ります。名前が呼ばれたら、番号を確認してから手を上げます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 前席へ移り番号照合後手を上げると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will move to a front seat that does not block the aisle. When my name is called, I will check the number before raising my hand.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide to move to a front seat and raise your hand after checking the number. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 次のご案内は、担当へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will check with the person in charge about what happens next.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まだ検査前なので、見える前の席へ戻ります。手を上げる合図で、次の呼出しに答えて待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 検査前と確認し前席で手上げ合図により次呼出しへ応答して待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Since I have not had my examination yet, I will return to the visible front seat. I will wait and respond to the next call by raising my hand.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that your examination is still ahead and wait in the front seat, responding to the next call with a raised hand. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご希望を担当へ申し送ります。それでは、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will pass your wishes on to the person in charge. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 道案内について、何か気になることがありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there something concerning you about the directions?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 駅への近道を聞かれ、ある家の庭を抜けられると言ってしまいました。私もその庭を通ったことはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 他人庭の通抜けを未体験なのに近道として教えたと申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Someone asked for a shortcut to the station, and I told them they could go through someone's garden. I have never gone through that garden myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that you recommended cutting through someone else's garden as a shortcut despite never having done so. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どなたへ、いつお伝えになりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Who did you tell, and when?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: さっき知らない方へ話しました。地図で近そうに見えただけで、通行できる道だと確かめたわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 直前の相手と地図上近さのみの推測を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I told a stranger just now. It only looked close on the map; I did not verify that it was a route people could use.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain whom you told just now and that it was only a guess based on proximity on the map. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その方はまだお近くにいますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 向こうで地図を見ています。追いかけて庭へ誘導せず、通れると確認した道ではないと訂正したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 相手が近くにいて未確認案内を訂正したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: They are looking at a map over there. Instead of chasing after them to lead them through the garden, I want to correct myself and say I have not confirmed it is passable.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that the person is nearby and you want to correct the unverified directions. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 相手に話す際は、ご自身の推測だったことをお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: When you speak to them, please explain that it was your own guess.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。庭の持ち主に頼めば必ず通してもらえるとも言いません。普通の道から行くよう案内を聞いてもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 庭主の許可を保証せず通常道案内へ替える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I will not say that the owner will definitely let them through if asked, either. I will suggest that they ask for directions using ordinary roads.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Do not guarantee the garden owner's permission; switch to directions using regular roads. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 正式な経路の案内が必要なら、こちらでも伺えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: If they need official route guidance, we can help here, too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まず自分の間違った説明を取り消し、その方が希望したらこちらへ道順を尋ねてもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自分の説明を撤回後相手希望に応じ警察経路相談へつなぐ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: First I will withdraw my mistaken explanation, and if they wish, I will have them ask here for directions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Retract your own directions, then connect the person with police route advice if they wish. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 分かりました。お気をつけてお声掛けください。それでは、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please take care when approaching them. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの封筒に書かれた小さい番号は、宛先の一部ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is the small number written on this envelope part of the address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私が手紙の枚数を数えた時のメモです。部屋番号のように住所の下へ残してしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 封筒下の小数字は住所でなく手紙枚数メモと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is a note I made when counting the sheets in my letter. I left it beneath the address as though it were a room number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the small digits below the address are a note of the letter's sheet count, not part of the address. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 宛先と区別できるようにしていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Could you make it distinguishable from the address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 線で消すだけだと数字が読めるので、新しい封筒へ住所を書きます。手紙を九枚という意味で、部屋は九号室ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 九枚と九号室を区別し新封筒へ住所を書直すと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: The number would still be legible if I just crossed it out, so I will write the address on a new envelope. It means nine sheets, not room nine.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish nine sheets from room nine and say you will rewrite the address on a new envelope. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 実際の部屋番号は、受取人へ確認していますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Have you confirmed the actual room number with the recipient?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 受取人は一戸建てで、部屋番号はありません。数字を消すつもりで架空の部屋番号を追加することもやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 受取人一戸建てで不存在部屋番号を足さないと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: The recipient lives in a detached house and has no room number. I will also avoid adding an imaginary room number in an attempt to erase the digits.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that the recipient lives in a detached house and you will not add a nonexistent room number. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 手紙の枚数のメモは、ほかに残しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Will you keep the note of the sheet count somewhere else?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 自分の手帳へ書きます。発送の窓口で使う番号だと受け取られないよう、封筒の外には書きません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 枚数を手帳へ移し封筒外に内部メモを残さない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will put it in my own notebook. I will not write it on the outside of the envelope, so it is not mistaken for a number used at the mailing counter.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Move the sheet count to your notebook and leave no internal note on the envelope's exterior. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 新しい封筒を記入できましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Have you finished filling in the new envelope?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 書けました。番地は元の案内と一致していて、枚数の九はありません。古い封筒は自分で持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 原番地一致と枚数九の除去を確認し旧封筒を持帰る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. The street number matches the original instructions, and the nine for the sheet count is gone. I will take the old envelope home myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that the original street number matches and the sheet-count nine is removed, and take the old envelope home. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 宛先を確認します。それでは、お預かりいたします。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will check the address. Then I will accept this. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日はどのようなご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: What would you like to discuss today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 来週出張で家を空けます。銀行へも来なければと思いましたが、用件が旅行の説明だけになってしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 出張説明だけになった相談用件を整理したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I will be away from home on business next week. I thought I needed to come to the bank too, but I ended up only explaining my trip.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you want to clarify your request after only explaining the business trip. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 口座について、どの手続きを確認したいのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which account procedure would you like to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 家賃の振込日が出張中なので、留守でも支払える方法を知りたいです。旅行保険の相談ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 不在中家賃振込方法の相談で旅行保険でないと明示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: My rent transfer date falls during the business trip, so I want to know how to pay while away. I am not asking about travel insurance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Make clear that you are asking how to transfer rent while away, not about travel insurance. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご利用の方法と条件を担当が確認します。今使っている方法は何ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: The person in charge will check the methods and conditions available to you. How do you pay now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: いつも窓口から払っています。電話だけで申込みできると聞いたわけではなく、使える方法を初めて相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 通常窓口利用で電話受付を断定せず方法を初相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I always pay at the counter. I have not heard that I can apply just by phone; this is my first time asking what methods I can use.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you normally use the counter and are asking about methods for the first time without assuming phone applications are accepted. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご本人の利用状況に合わせて、ご案内できる方法を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check which methods we can offer based on your own usage situation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 自分がすぐ使えるとは決めず、準備に何が必要か聞きます。出張前に整わなければ別の支払日も貸主へ相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 利用準備を尋ね間に合わなければ貸主へ日程相談と述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will not assume I can use one immediately; I will ask what preparation is needed. If I cannot get ready before the trip, I will also discuss another payment date with my landlord.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask about preparations and say you will consult the landlord about timing if they cannot be completed in time. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 支払いの期限については、貸主との約束をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check your agreement with the landlord regarding the payment deadline.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 銀行では使える手段と準備を聞き、貸主へは期限を確認します。出張する事情だけで支払いが自動的に延期されるとは考えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 銀行手段と貸主期限を分け出張で自動延期と思わない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: At the bank I will ask about available methods and preparations, and with the landlord I will confirm the deadline. I do not think payment is automatically postponed just because I am going on a business trip.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Separate the bank's payment methods from the landlord's deadline and do not assume a business trip automatically postpones payment. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当へ相談をおつなぎします。それでは、失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will connect you with the person in charge. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お探しの物は見つかりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Did you find what you were looking for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 料理会で三人が別々に買います。友人から赤い袋と言われましたが、同じ色が何種類もあって選べません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 共同料理の赤袋指定だけでは商品を選べないと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Three of us are buying things separately for a cooking gathering. My friend told me to get a red bag, but there are several kinds in the same color, so I cannot choose.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for help because a red-bag instruction alone does not identify the product for group cooking. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 商品名や用途は聞いていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you been told the product name or what it is for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 用途は揚げ物の衣です。でも、私が何の粉でも同じと決めず、友人へ商品名を送ってもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 衣用途でも粉同一視せず友人へ正式商品名を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is for coating fried food. But I will not decide that all powders are the same; I will ask my friend to send me the product name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Even for a frying coating, do not treat all powders as identical; ask your friend for the exact product name. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お返事を待つ間は、商品を開けずにご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: While waiting for a reply, please look without opening the products.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 写真が届きました。この片栗粉ですね。小麦粉の写真だと思って見ていたので、名前まで読み直せてよかったです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 受信写真を読んで片栗粉と小麦粉を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: The photo arrived. It is this potato starch. I had been looking at it thinking it was a photo of wheat flour, so I am glad I read the name again too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Read the received photo and distinguish potato starch from wheat flour. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらは片栗粉です。調理方法は、料理を担当する方へ確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: This is potato starch. Please check the cooking method with the person doing the cooking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 買う袋は開けずに持って行きます。どの粉か分からなくなるので、自分で透明な袋へ移し替えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 調理担当へ確認し原袋維持で粉名称を残す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will take the bag I buy without opening it. I will not transfer it to a clear bag myself, because then we would lose track of which powder it is.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check with the cook and retain the original bag so that the powder's name is preserved. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 人数に合わせた量も、ご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also check the amount needed for the number of people.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 友人にこの容量で足りると確認しました。三人分を私一人で買い足さず、指定された一袋だけにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 容量確認後に他二人分を買足さず指定一袋を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: My friend confirmed this size is enough. I will get only the one specified bag, without buying extra for all three people on my own.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: After checking the capacity, choose the specified single bag without buying extra for the other two people. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、その一袋をお選びください。お買物をお楽しみください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please choose that one bag. Enjoy your shopping. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 交流会で読む文章のことで、ご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about the piece you will read at the social gathering?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 自分の詩を読みます。初めに「ここで待っている」とありますが、実際の集合案内だと思われないようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自作詩のここで待つ表現が実集合案内と誤解されないよう相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I will read my own poem. It begins 'I am waiting here,' but I want to avoid people thinking it is actual meeting instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how to prevent 'waiting here' in your own poem being mistaken for real meeting instructions. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 読む前に、自作の詩だとご紹介いただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Before reading, you can introduce it as a poem you wrote.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 最初にそう言います。詩の中の約束を、今日の会の参加者へ待っていてと頼む意味にはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自作詩と前置きし参加者への待機依頼ではないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will say that at the start. The promise in the poem is not meant as a request for the people attending today's gathering to wait.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Introduce it as your own poem and say it is not a request for attendees to wait. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 場所の言葉も、作品として分かるようにできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Can you also make the location wording clear as part of the work?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 「思い出の坂道で待っている」にします。今いる公園の出口を指定する言葉は入れません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 記憶の坂道へ表現変更し現公園出口指定を入れない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will change it to 'I am waiting on the slope in my memories.' I will not include wording specifying the exit of the park where we are now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Change the expression to a slope in your memories and do not specify the current park exit. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 読む長さは、どのくらいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: How long will the reading take?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ゆっくり読んで一分ほどです。読む前の紹介も含め、他の人の時間を使い過ぎないよう短くします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 紹介込み約一分の朗読で他者時間を圧迫しないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: About a minute if I read slowly. I will keep it short, including the introduction before the reading, so I do not take too much of other people's time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that the reading will take about a minute including the introduction and will not crowd out others' time. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 次の方へ移る合図はこちらからお知らせします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will signal when it is time for the next person.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 終わったら自分で最後まで読んだと伝え、拍手がなくても続きの文章を足して時間を延ばしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 終了を示し拍手なしでも文章追加で延長しないと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: When I finish, I will say that I have read to the end. Even if there is no applause, I will not add more text and extend my time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Mark the end and decide not to extend the time by adding text even without applause. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、発表を楽しみにしております。当日はよろしくお願いします。さようなら。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25211-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: We look forward to your presentation. Thank you in advance for the day. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: まだ改札へ入らず、お待ちでしたね。どうされましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: You were waiting without entering the ticket gates. What happened?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人が急に来られなくなり、今日の外出をやめます。列車の遅れを待っているのではなく、切符をどうすればよいか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 外出中止と遅延待機ではない用件を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: My friend suddenly cannot come, so I am canceling today's outing. I am not waiting for a delayed train; I want to ask what to do with my ticket.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you canceled the outing and are not waiting because of a delay. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 買った切符と、購入の方法を確認させてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please let me check the ticket you bought and how you purchased it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 窓口で今朝買いました。現金で払い、ここまで歩いてきました。改札には一度も入っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 現金購入と未入場を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I bought it at the counter this morning. I paid cash and walked here. I have not entered the ticket gates even once.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you bought it with cash and have not entered the gates. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 払戻しができるか、切符の条件を担当が確認します。次の日に使うご予定はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: The person in charge will check the ticket conditions to see whether it can be refunded. Do you plan to use it another day?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 次の予定も決まっていません。とりあえず明日へ変えるのではなく、中止の場合の扱いを知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 翌日変更でなく未定の中止扱いを求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: My next plans are not decided either. Rather than changing it to tomorrow for now, I want to know how cancellations are handled.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about cancellation with future plans undecided, rather than changing it to the following day. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの窓口で確認します。手数料がある場合も、先にご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check at this counter. If there is a fee, we will explain it first too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。切符代が全部戻るとは考えず、確認した額を聞いてから手続きを選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 返金全額を前提にせず額確認後に選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. I will not assume all the fare will be returned; I will choose a procedure after hearing the confirmed amount.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Do not assume a full refund; choose after confirming the amount. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お買い求めの控えも、お持ちでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Do you also have your proof of purchase?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 財布にありました。切符と控えを出します。友人との予定を決め直すのは後にして、今日はこの切符だけを相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 切符控えを示し今日の取扱に相談を絞る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I found it in my wallet. I will take out the ticket and receipt. I will reschedule with my friend later and ask only about this ticket today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show the ticket and receipt, and limit today's request to how this ticket will be handled. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、担当が条件を確認します。ご用意ありがとうございました。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25212-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then the person in charge will check the conditions. Thank you for preparing everything. Goodbye.
